The Chinese characters for Daisy

As a transliteration, Daisy is usually written 黛西 (Dài xī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

黛
Dài
dark blue (eyebrow pigment)
西
xī
west

Origin and meaning

Daisy comes from English and means “day's eye (a flower)”.

About the name Daisy

A flower name from 'day's eye', and the heroine of The Great Gatsby.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Daisy as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “day's eye (a flower)”, is part of the appeal.
